name.value: The Bog at Riverside Cranberry Farm

description.value: A multi-generational family cranberry farm nestled along the Fraser River in Glen Valley, Langley, with views of Mt. Baker and the surrounding Fraser Valley. The farm sells premium cranberry products — including cold-pressed juice, sauces, jams, freeze-dried berries, and chocolate-covered cranberries — from a seasonal on-site farm store and a year-round online shop. In fall, the popular 'Cranberry Plunge' lets visitors wade into a flooded, berry-covered bog for a quintessentially BC harvest experience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, URL). The farm sells cranberry products (juices, sauces, jams, frozen/dried berries) from a seasonal physical farm store and a year-round online store, fitting the 'Groceries' category as a farm-direct food retailer. No evidence exists on the website for bike-specific amenities (parking, racks, water refill, pump, etc.), so those are all null.
concerns: Physical farm store is seasonal and currently closed; website states it will reopen 'Summer of 2026'. Cyclists visiting off-season will find no on-site retail. Listing should make this seasonal limitation clear.
Harvest tours and the Cranberry Plunge are available only in a narrow fall window (late September to mid-October); not relevant for most cycling-season visits.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active farm-direct food retailer near Fort Langley — a well-known cycling destination — selling local BC cranberry products; unique enough as a farm-tourism attraction to be valuable to touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email confirmed from website: info@riversidecranberries.ca (not present in OSM tags). The farm is Canada GAP certified; no pets allowed on site.

Basic groceries.detail: Farm store sells cranberry food products including frozen cranberries, juices, sauces, jams, and dried berries; store is seasonal (closed until Summer 2026) but online ordering with curbside pickup is available year-round
